common.beacon_not_configured_warning: Initial setup isn't finished — {link}. Browsing is unaffected; the Override/Rearm actions on item pages are blocked until beacon identity (the wizard's first step) is set.
config.leave_unchanged: leave unchanged to keep current value
settings.UI_DEFAULT_LOCALE.label: Default language
settings.UI_DEFAULT_LOCALE.description: Fallback UI language when a visitor's browser doesn't send a recognized Accept-Language and they haven't chosen one yet. A visitor's own choice (the EN/ES toggle) always overrides this, stored in a per-browser cookie. Applies live — no restart needed.
settings.UI_DEFAULT_THEME.label: Default theme
settings.UI_DEFAULT_THEME.description: Fallback color theme for a visitor who hasn't chosen one yet. A visitor's own choice (the System/Light/Dark toggle) always overrides this, stored in a per-browser cookie. "System" follows the visitor's OS/browser preference. Applies live — no restart needed.
